# raidbots

Raidbots report consumption and local SimC handoff CLI.

## Global options

Pass these before the subcommand: `raidbots --pretty <command> ...`.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--pretty` | boolean | false | Pretty-print JSON for human reading. Default output is compact JSON. |
| `--compact` | boolean | false | Truncate long string fields to reduce payload size. |
| `--fields` | str (repeatable) |  | Return only selected fields (dot paths). Repeat or pass comma-separated values. |
| `--fields-strict` | boolean | false | Fail when a requested --fields dot-path is missing from the payload. |
| `--profile` | str |  | Output profile preset: agent (default compact JSON), human (pretty JSON), debug (pretty JSON + diagnostics). |
| `--compact-max-chars` | int range | 280 | Maximum string length before --compact truncation adds an ellipsis. |

## raidbots doctor

Report Raidbots capabilities, cache configuration, and the resolved report URL templates.

## raidbots search

Emit the not-supported search stub: Raidbots publishes no report index.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | str | required | Free-text query (Raidbots has no searchable report index). |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | int range | 10 | Maximum results to return; kept for cross-provider parity. |

## raidbots resolve

Emit the not-supported resolve stub: only a known report URL or ID can be opened.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | str | required | Free-text target (use `inspect-report` with a known report). |

## raidbots inspect-report

Fetch and parse a Raidbots report into a kind-aware summary with freshness and citations.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reference` | str | required | Raidbots report URL or bare report ID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--no-raw` | boolean | false | Omit the raw data.json payload (recommended for large Top Gear/Droptimizer reports). |

## raidbots input

Fetch a report's SimC input and suggest the local `simc` commands that consume it.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reference` | str | required | Raidbots report URL or bare report ID. |

## raidbots explain-input

Classify SimC addon/profile text locally and explain the Raidbots-to-simc handoff. No network.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--text` | str |  | Inline SimC addon/profile text. |
| `--file` | str |  | Path to a file containing SimC addon/profile text. |
